description.en: DailyReport is a benchmark with 150 open-ended daily search tasks and 3,546 rubrics, evaluating search agents on information-seeking tasks. Tasks are decomposed into subtasks with cascade rubrics across dimensions, yielding interpretable scores and a user preference score.

evidence.snippet: To bridge this gap, we introduce DailyReport, an open-ended benchmark to evaluate SA capabilities on daily search tasks.

claire_radar.motivation: Search Agents (SAs) typically leverage large language models (LLMs) to support complex information-seeking tasks by autonomously exploring web sources and synthesizing information into comprehensive responses.

source.title: DailyReport: An Open-ended Benchmark for Evaluating Search Agents on Daily Search Tasks

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing search agent benchmarks often use specialized or artificial tasks with coarse scoring, limiting interpretability and real-world relevance. DailyReport provides a more user-centric evaluation protocol for daily search tasks, offering fine-grained, dimension-level scores to inform agent development.
